tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Find businesses listed on BOP in Taiwan (personal trainers and coaches, gyms, group-class studios, saunas, recovery services) by keyword and/or category, with a few of their services and prices. Use this when the user wants to find a coach, gym, class or studio in Taiwan, or wants to book or check t

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Get one business's public profile (city, address, hours, booking and cancellation policy, contact, FAQ) and its active services with prices, durations and weekly schedules. Use this after search_businesses, or when the user names a business, before checking open times. Read-only.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: List open time slots (Asia/Taipei) for one service in the next 1–14 days, with remaining capacity. Use this when the user asks when they can go or wants a particular day or time (e.g. 「週日早上有空嗎」), and pick the slots on that day and time. Use the returned slot value as-is in request_booking. Read-only

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Create a booking (訂課、預約) for one open slot on behalf of the customer, after the customer has agreed to the service, time, quantity and contact details. Sends the customer's name, phone and email to the business. The result is either 'confirmed' or 'pending' (waiting for the business to confirm). Pay

tools.name: complete_booking
tools.description: Pay for a booking (付款) whose status is awaiting_payment, with a payment credential the customer approved for the booking's amount and currency. payment.handler_id must come from the booking's payment_handlers ("stripe_payments"), and credential is {type: "stripe_payment_token", token: "spt_…"}: a St

tools.name: modify_booking
tools.description: Change the slot or quantity (改時間、改人數) of a pending, awaiting_payment or confirmed booking, when the customer asks to. Replaces the booking's time or quantity and frees the old place. Use a slot value from get_availability. A booking paid online can change its slot but not its quantity (cancel and re

tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: Get the current status of a booking made with request_booking (查預約狀態: confirmed, waiting for the business, awaiting online payment, declined, or cancelled), including payment and refund details. Read-only.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel (取消預約) a confirmed, pending or awaiting_payment booking made with request_booking, when the customer asks to. Frees the place for others and cannot be undone; a booking paid online is refunded minus the card processing fee Stripe charged and BOP's fee (5.5% + NT$10). Online cancellation close

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: For businesses whose booking_mode is external_link: get a link to the business's own booking page for one service. The click is counted for the business. Booking and payment happen on that page.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_booking · Private data: get_business, request_booking, complete_booking · Public sink: request_booking · Destructive: modify_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_booking · Private data: get_business, request_booking, complete_booking · Public sink: request_booking · Destructive: modify_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
